title: Avatar: The Last Airbender Eternal: card flavor text

entities.name: Aang
entities.description: The young Airbender Avatar, taught by Monk Gyatso and guided by Avatar Roku. He is hunted by Zuko.

entities.name: Katara
entities.description: A Waterbender who helped liberate prisoners and rallies Earthbenders against the Fire Nation.

entities.name: Sokka
entities.description: A Water Tribe swordsman who protects Wolf Cove. His first girlfriend turned into the moon.

entities.name: Toph
entities.description: A powerful Earthbender who can feel through the ground with her earthbending.

entities.name: Zuko
entities.description: Prince of the Fire Nation and heir to the throne, scarred by his father. He hunted the Avatar to regain his honor but says he has changed.

entities.name: Iroh
entities.description: A tea-loving firebending master and mentor to Zuko who learned to redirect lightning by studying Waterbenders.

entities.name: Azula
entities.description: A sharp and enduring opponent of Aang, cared for by Lo and Li.

entities.name: Momo
entities.description: A winged lemur of Team Avatar who searched in vain for his lost friend Appa.

entities.name: Appa
entities.description: Aang's sky bison companion, who went missing.

entities.name: Master Piandao
entities.description: A sword master who taught swordsmanship.

entities.name: Wan Shi Tong
entities.description: A spirit who rewards those who provide rare and insightful tomes.

entities.name: Unagi
entities.description: A sea creature whose spray can blast ships to pieces and humble showboating Avatars.

entities.name: Dai Li
entities.description: The cultural authority of Ba Sing Se and guardians of all Earth Kingdom traditions.

entities.name: Ba Sing Se
entities.description: A walled city of the Earth Kingdom.

entities.name: Earth Kingdom
entities.description: One of the four nations, with humble villages and the city of Ba Sing Se.

entities.name: Fire Nation
entities.description: An aggressive nation waging the Hundred Year War against the other nations.

entities.name: Lo and Li
entities.description: Royal advisors concerned for Azula's well-being who speak of Ember Island.

entities.name: The Duke
entities.description: A rebel sentry and royal pain to the Fire Nation.

entities.name: Pipsqueak
entities.description: A rebel strongarm sensitive about his name.

entities.name: Longshot
entities.description: A rebel bowman who rarely used words.

entities.name: Smellerbee
entities.description: A rebel fighter confident in who she is.

entities.name: Jet
entities.description: Leader of the Freedom Fighters, who planned to blow a dam.

entities.name: Jet's Freedom Fighters
entities.description: A dangerous band of lost children whose strength lies in purpose, numbers, and bond.

entities.name: Moku
entities.description: A meandering drummer who marches to the beat of a different drum.

entities.name: Misty Palms Oasis
entities.description: An oasis where deer-dogs nap in the shade as pets.

entities.name: Crystal Catacombs
entities.description: Catacombs that offered Aang crystal armor against Azula.

entities.name: Kyoshi Warriors
entities.description: Warriors named after an Avatar who fight with dedication, strategy, and ferocity.

entities.name: Avatar Kyoshi
entities.description: A past Avatar who is the namesake of the Kyoshi Warriors.

entities.name: Suki
entities.description: Captain of the Kyoshi Warriors who teaches using an opponent's force against them.

entities.name: The Blue Spirit
entities.description: A masked figure of uncertain allegiance who fought alongside Aang when under attack.

entities.name: Si Wong Desert
entities.description: A harsh desert where Momo searched for Appa and buzzard-wasps scour for prey.

entities.name: Long Feng
entities.description: A man seeking to regain control of Ba Sing Se through a deal.

entities.name: Avatar Roku
entities.description: A past Avatar and Firebender who mastered all four elements and guides Aang.

entities.name: Sozin's Comet
entities.description: A comet whose arrival marks a moment of destiny.

entities.name: Monk Gyatso
entities.description: An Air Nomad monk who taught Aang to live with joy.

entities.name: Princess Yue
entities.description: A princess who speaks of the moon and ocean spirits.

entities.name: Tui and La
entities.description: The spirits of the moon and ocean who work together to keep balance.

entities.name: Wolf Cove
entities.description: A slow-paced Water Tribe village in the snow protected by Sokka.

entities.name: Water Tribe
entities.description: The nation of Sokka and Katara's people.

entities.name: Serpent's Pass
entities.description: A pass home to a terrifying serpent.

entities.name: Spirit World
entities.description: A place of infinite wonders and endless perils.

entities.name: Hama
entities.description: A former prisoner who recalls rats in her cage.

entities.name: Foggy Swamp
entities.description: A swamp full of mysterious sounds where people see visions of those they've lost.

entities.name: Makapu Village
entities.description: A desirable farming village beneath a volcano.

entities.name: Ba Sing Se Zoo
entities.description: A zoo that became a safe haven for animals with the Avatar's aid.

entities.name: Ember Island
entities.description: An island said to give everyone a clean slate and reveal the true self.

entities.name: Huu
entities.description: A dweller of the Foggy Swamp who speaks of its visions.

entities.name: Sun Warriors
entities.description: A people who ensure aardvark sloths can eat fire ants.

entities.name: Hundred Year War
entities.description: The long war during which Fire Nation soldiers spread like wildfire.

entities.name: Guru Pathik
entities.description: A guru who teaches that all the elements are one.

entities.name: Monk Tashi
entities.description: A monk who told Aang he chose the four Avatar relics.

entities.name: Avatar relics
entities.description: Four items that belonged to past Avatars, chosen by Aang from among thousands of toys.

entities.name: Zhao
entities.description: A Fire Nation firebender who challenges the Avatar.

entities.name: The Cabbage Merchant
entities.description: A merchant whose cabbages keep getting destroyed.

entities.name: Team Avatar
entities.description: The Avatar's group of companions.

entities.name: Fire Lord
entities.description: The ruler of the Fire Nation, whom Aang must fight.

entities.name: Jennamite
entities.description: A fast-growing crystal that is also a delicious candy.

events.summary: Katara turns coal meant to fuel enemy ships into fuel for the prisoners' liberation.
events.quote: Thanks to Katara, the coal meant to fuel enemy ships instead fueled the prisoners' liberation.
Sokka mastered the sword like his friends mastered the elements.

events.summary: Momo despairs at finding Appa's empty pawprint after Appa is lost.
events.quote: Rain filled Appa's pawprint, and despair filled Momo's heart.

events.summary: Sokka recalls that his first girlfriend turned into the moon.
events.quote: "My first girlfriend turned into the moon."

events.summary: Memory: Zuko's scar recalls the day he refused to fight his father and the brutal lessons that followed.
events.quote: Zuko's scar reminded him of the day he refused to fight his father, and the brutal lessons that followed.

events.summary: Aang gains crystal armor in the Crystal Catacombs to face Azula.
events.quote: The Crystal Catacombs offered Aang sharp and enduring armor

events.summary: Aang and the Blue Spirit come under attack together.
events.quote: Once Aang and The Blue Spirit were under attack, it was unclear which one was rescuing the other.

events.summary: Sokka realizes Firebenders lose their bending during a solar eclipse.
events.quote: Firebenders lose their bending during a solar eclipse!

events.summary: Momo searches in vain for his lost friend over the Si Wong Desert.
events.quote: In the skies of the Si Wong Desert, a solitary winged lemur searched in vain for a lost friend.

events.summary: Long Feng proposes a deal to regain control of Ba Sing Se.
events.quote: It's time that I regain control of Ba Sing Se, and you have something I need.

events.summary: Avatar Roku reveals to Aang the truth behind Sozin's Comet.
events.quote: Avatar Roku showed Aang the truth behind Sozin's Comet.

events.summary: Iroh learns to redirect lightning by studying Waterbenders.
events.quote: By studying the ways of the Waterbenders, Iroh learned how to redirect lightning.

events.summary: Iroh reconciles with Zuko, saying he was never angry, only sad.
events.quote: "I was never angry with you. I was sad, because I was afraid you'd lost your way."

events.summary: The Avatar disputes the fortune teller about Makapu Village's volcano.
events.quote: Though the local fortune teller claimed the volcano was dormant, the Avatar thought otherwise.

events.summary: With the Avatar's aid, the Ba Sing Se Zoo becomes a haven for animals.
events.quote: With the Avatar's aid, the Ba Sing Se Zoo became a safe haven for animals across the four nations.

events.summary: Jet orders that the dam not be blown until his signal.
events.quote: "You're not to blow the dam until I give the signal."

events.summary: Katara asks Toph for help against overwhelming numbers.
events.quote: "Toph, there's too many of them. We need an Earthbender. We need you."

relations.note: Taught Aang to live with joy.
relations.quote: Monk Gyatso taught Aang many things, most importantly to live with joy.

relations.note: Showed Aang the truth of Sozin's Comet.
relations.quote: Avatar Roku showed Aang the truth behind Sozin's Comet.

relations.quote: Wolf Cove's snow fort doubles as Sokka's watchtower and a playground for Water Tribe children.
